messages:
sam: Heads up — EdgeWave flagged a batch of retroactive entitlements (June–Aug) that weren't applied to marketplace invoices. They think ~3.2k usage units were omitted on our side. Can partnerships + billing triage?
priya: ugh. do we have a quick sample of the missing records? 
sam: pasted the partner summary they sent: 
```
{
  "partner": "EdgeWave",
  "period": "2025-06 to 2025-08",
  "claimed_units": 3200,
  "reported_to_marketplace": 3200,
  "invoiced_by_redwood": 0
}
```
priya: thanks. first pass: we need to align three sources — partner ledger, marketplace usage export, and our internal ingestion logs. i can run a market-export diff but need an example event id.
derek: i can run a dedupe/replay on the ingestion side. can someone drop a sample event id and timestamp? i'll run the script with --dry-run first.
sam: sample event they included: ew-evt-20250614-9f3b. timestamp 1713500400 (they had their local ts).
marketplace-bot: Automated export uploaded: s3://marketplace-exports/edgewave/2025-08/usage_export_20250831.json (sha256: e3b0c442...)
priya: ok i'll pull that and run a checksum/row-count against our hourly rollups. steps i propose: 1) validate marketplace export record counts 2) map event ids to our raw-ingest table 3) determine whether ingestion filtered them (policy filters / entitlement mismatch) 4) if filtered, check why (sku mapping? timezone?)
nana: typo — i'm ana (legal) — quick Q: if we owe a retroactive credit, do we handle as negative invoice line item or an ad-hoc credit memo? need to know for contract + rev recognition.
priya: good q. billing preference is credit memo, but finance needs signoff. i'll loop in finance once counts are confirmed.
james: FYI had an earlier run where timezone offsets caused hourly to drop into previous day and our windowing dedup logic tossed them. sending snippet: 
```
-- sample SQL to find mismatches
SELECT partner_event_id, count(*) as cnt, min(received_at) as first_seen
FROM raw_ingest
WHERE partner = 'EdgeWave' AND received_at BETWEEN '2025-06-01' AND '2025-08-31'
GROUP BY partner_event_id
HAVING cnt = 0;
```
priya: james — small correction: HAVING cnt = 0 won't return rows. use LEFT JOIN to marketplace export to find missing ones.
derek: i'm going to run the dedupe script now in staging: `./tools/replay_ingest --partner edgewave --from 2025-06-01 --to 2025-08-31 --dry-run` will post results in #eng-runtime when done.
sam: can we also capture the entitlement id mapping? partner uses sku EW-HW-100 vs our mapping EW-HARDWARE-100. if we mis-map, policy filters drop them.
priya: documented mapping lives in repo: `infra/partner_mappings/edgewave.yml` — i'll sanity-check.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace reconciliation job completed: 2025-09-04 15:12 UTC. Summary: 3,200 partner rows vs 2,805 matched rows in redwood. 395 unmatched. See link: https://internal.apps/redwood-recon/edgewave/2025-Q3
sam: that matches partner claim-ish — around ~395 missing is fewer than 3200 but we need full reconciliation. can we get a CSV of unmatched ids?
priya: grabbing it now. once i have CSV i'll run a join with our raw logs to see if they were ingested and then filtered.
a na: typo again — ana: also note contract clause 4.2 about backdated credits — we may be capped at 90 days. EdgeWave says they have device telemetry delays. legal will need the device evidence to approve any credit beyond 90 days.
james: good catch. that changes outcome if devices delayed by partner. we should flag which events are >90 days old from invoice run date.
derek: replay dry-run complete — looks like ~380 records would be accepted if remapped. posting diff: s3://redwood-temp/edgewave/replay-diff-3187654321.json
sam: next steps/action owners: sam to coordinate partner comms, priya to reconcile exports + create CSV of unmatched, derek to run replay (non-dry run) pending approvals, ana to check contract allowance and advise on credit memo format, james to check mapping and fix edgewave.yml if needed.
priya: estimated ETA for CSV and initial reconciliation: EOD today. will ping here when ready. :thumbsup:
sam: thanks all. i'll draft partner update mentioning we found mapping/windowing issues and are doing a remap + replay; will hold on credits until legal/finance confirm.
marketplace-bot: Created ticket RW-PRT-4521: "EdgeWave retroactive entitlement reconciliation" — assignees: priya, derek, sam. Link: https://tickets.redwood/RW-PRT-4521
priya: added finance contact @maria-finance to ticket. will schedule 30m sync if we need to approve credit memo.
james: i'll patch mapping now and create a small unit test to avoid regressions.
priya: all good — keep updates here.
(END)
